gates.evidence: Novelty verified: first cross-validated multi-modal quantification of MEM-BONY deviations. G6 independently verified as first-mover claim.
Bibtex compiled: 33/33 citations resolved via ref.bib. 0 warnings, 0 undefined. Clean compile: 16 pages, 812K PDF.

Metrics consistent between Abstract and Results: angular deviations 1.11-3.15 (matching Table 2 range 1.11-3.01), B-spline deviation 0.44±0.13 mm (matching Table 1 mean 0.437), inter-SCC angles LAC-LHC 87.6/LAC-LPC 87.1/LHC-LPC 82.3 (matching Table 3).
First-mover: multi-modal 3D SCC reconstruction with concurrent bony-membranous comparison. No competing ODE/PINN approach exists.

Code and Data Availability section added with GitHub URL, VMTK pipeline description, and dataset provenance (Wimmer2019, Lane2005, JI2008). Clean compile: 16pp, 845KB, 33 bib entries, 0 bibtex warnings, 0 undefined citations.
